about: Pass 8 (2026-10-09/10): new text/multimodal LLMs released or updated since ~2026-07 that are not in data/models.json, plus LLM gap models named by earlier passes (gaps-all.json), each with results from allowed sources (vendor own-model scores under rule b, openly licensed cards/papers incl. the authors' own comparator runs, LMArena CC BY dataset, Vectara Apache README). Candidates only: nothing in data/ was edited. Produced by a coordinator plus five forks (A frontier API, B Chinese labs, C Western/other, D Korean + NVIDIA gaps, E Qwen-VL family); the forks were stopped by a usage limit and the coordinator finished group C and merged. Validation: every model id is new (no id, name or model_repo clash with data/models.json), every row resolves to an existing or proposed ledger id whose match covers its URL, no row duplicates data/results.json (model+bench+source_id) or another part, every bench id exists in data/benchmarks.json.

results.note: Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, Table 8.1.A 'Capability evaluation summary', row 'SWE-Bench Pro', column 'Haiku 5.5' = 64.8 (also §8.2 p.112: 'Claude Haiku 5.5 achieved 64.8%'); standard configuration per caption: adaptive thinking at max effort, default sampling settings, averaged over five trials, context <=1M; public/commercial split not stated (problems 'drawn from actively-maintained repositories with large, multi-file diffs'); vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, Table 8.1.A, row 'SWE-bench Multilingual', column 'Haiku 5.5' = 83.7 (§8.2 p.112: 300 problems across 9 languages, 'Haiku 5.5 achieved 83.7%'); standard configuration per caption: adaptive thinking at max effort, default sampling settings, averaged over five trials, context <=1M; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, Table 8.1.A, row 'Humanity's Last Exam' / 'No tools', column 'Haiku 5.5' = 45.9. §8.8.1: full 2,500-question set, thinking auto at max effort, 980k-token task budget, no compaction, Claude Opus 4.6 grader; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, Table 8.1.A, row 'Humanity's Last Exam' / 'With tools', column 'Haiku 5.5' = 57.4. §8.8.1: web search, web fetch, programmatic tool calling and code execution, 980k-token task budget, no compaction, HLE blocklist, Claude Opus 4.6 grader; max effort; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, §8.4 'Terminal-Bench 4.0' prose: 'Claude Haiku 5.5 scored 39.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with safeguards enabled'; 66 tasks, 10 trials per task (660 trials), SE ±1.9 pts; Claude Code in --bare mode at max thinking effort; no fallback model (1.8% of trials stopped by safeguards, counted as failures); no internet egress (resources pre-cached); vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, §8.9.1 'Chartography' prose: 'Claude Haiku 5.5 scored 46.4% without tools and 86.2% with tools'; with-tools figure recorded (container with the image file, standard libraries and an image cropping tool); adaptive thinking at max effort; internal grading implementation with Gemini 3.5 Flash grader (as on the Surge AI leaderboard); averaged over five runs; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, §8.12.1 'GMMLU results' prose: 'Claude Haiku 5.5 achieved an average accuracy of 87.8% across 42 languages' (Global MMLU, full); adaptive thinking at max effort, safety classifiers on, blocked/unanswered questions (0.1%) left out of the average, single trial, no tools or custom system prompt (Figure 8.12.1.A caption); vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, Table 8.1.A, row 'SWE-bench Multilingual', column 'Haiku 4.5' = 67.4 (Anthropic's own earlier model, same-lab comparison column); averaged over five trials; Claude Haiku 4.5 has no effort setting (run with extended thinking); vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, Table 8.1.A, row 'Humanity's Last Exam' / 'No tools', column 'Haiku 4.5' = 10.2 (same-lab column). §8.8.1: Claude Haiku 4.5 has no effort setting, so it was run at several extended-thinking budgets; Claude Opus 4.6 grader; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, Table 8.1.A, row 'Humanity's Last Exam' / 'With tools', column 'Haiku 4.5' = 18.7 (same-lab column). §8.8.1: result at a 60K-token extended-thinking budget (close to its 64K output limit) with a 160K-token task budget to fit its 200K context; web search, web fetch, programmatic tool calling, code execution; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, §8.4 'Terminal-Bench 4.0' prose: 'Claude Haiku 4.5 scored 0.0%, passing none of its trials'; 10 trials per task (660 trials); Claude Code in --bare mode with a fixed thinking budget of 63,999 tokens ('as it predates effort levels'). A genuine floor result on a frontier agentic test (not a parse failure: the card reports trials run and failed); vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card, §8.9.1 'Chartography' prose: 'Claude Haiku 4.5 scored 6.4% without tools and 8.8% with tools'; with-tools figure recorded; Haiku 4.5 run at fixed extended-thinking budgets up to 32k (Figure 8.9.1.A caption); same tools and Gemini 3.5 Flash grader as the other models; five runs; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card, Table 8.1.A 'Capability evaluation summary' (p.251), row 'SWE-bench Pro', column 'Mythos Preview' = 77.8 (same value as the Mythos Preview System Card Table 6.3.A); standard configuration (adaptive thinking, max effort, five trials); split not stated; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card, Table 8.1.A 'Capability evaluation summary' (p.251), row 'SWE-bench Verified', column 'Mythos Preview' = 93.9 (same in the Mythos Preview System Card Table 6.3.A); adaptive thinking at max effort, averaged over five trials; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card, Table 8.1.A 'Capability evaluation summary' (p.251), row 'Humanity's Last Exam' / 'No tools', column 'Mythos Preview' = 56.8 (Mythos Preview System Card §6.10.1: 'scored 56.8% without tools', full 2,500 questions, Claude Opus 4.6 grader, max effort); vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card, Table 8.1.A 'Capability evaluation summary' (p.251), row 'Humanity's Last Exam' / 'With tools', column 'Mythos Preview' = 64.7 (Mythos Preview System Card §6.10.1: web search, web fetch, programmatic tool calling, code execution, context compaction every 50k tokens up to 3M tokens, HLE blocklist, Claude Opus 4.6 grader); vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card, Table 8.1.A 'Capability evaluation summary' (p.251), row 'CharXiv Reasoning' / 'No tools', column 'Mythos Preview' = 86.2 (newest grader, same table as the existing claude-opus-4-8 80.5 row); the Mythos Preview System Card (Table 6.3.A, older grader) prints 86.1, not used. 1,000 validation questions, adaptive thinking at max effort; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview System Card, Table 6.3.A 'Capability Evaluation Summary', row 'SWE-bench Multilingual', column 'Claude Mythos Preview' = 87.3%; standard configuration: adaptive thinking at max effort, default sampling, averaged over 5 trials; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview System Card, §6.8 'USAMO 2026': 'Claude Mythos Preview achieved a 97.6% score, averaging over 10 trials per problem using max effort and no tools' (also Table 6.3.A). MathArena methodology: proofs rewritten by Gemini 3.1 Pro, judged by a 3-model panel (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Mythos Preview), minimum score; the card notes two of three judges were Anthropic models; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview System Card, §6.10.2 'BrowseComp': 'Claude Mythos Preview scored 86.9% with adaptive thinking at max effort and a 3M token limit. Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview System Card, §6.5 'Terminal-Bench 2.0': 'Claude Mythos Preview achieved 82% mean reward, averaged over 5 attempts for each one of the 89 unique tasks (for a total of 445 trials)'; Harbor scaffold, Terminus-2 harness, default parser, 1x resources and timeouts, max effort (adaptive), 1M total tokens per task, 32K max output per request. Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview System Card, §6.7 'MMMLU': 'achieves 92.67% averaged over 5 trials on all non-English language pairings' (14 languages; Table 6.3.A prints 92.7%); adaptive thinking, max effort, default sampling; vendor-reported (rule b)

Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview System Card, Table 6.3.A, row 'Terminal-Bench 2.0*', column 'Claude Opus 4.6' = 65.4% (Anthropic's own model; caption: 'All other scores used the Terminus-2 harness'; earlier-model details per the Claude Opus 4.6 System Card); vendor-reported (rule b)
